verdict.rationale: GrowthBook offers 24 official SDKs spanning backend, web/React, and mobile (Android/iOS) per GitHub README, with docs showing consistent flag-evaluation patterns (useFeatureIsOn, useFeatureValue, targeting attributes evaluated locally) and community reports of quick multi-stack integration (Vue frontend in hours). An older 2021 community comment noted no native mobile SDKs yet, but this is superseded by the more recent GitHub claim explicitly listing Android/iOS SDKs, so it's not a live contradiction. Missing for 10: independent verification of identical targeting/rollout behavior across all 24 SDKs, and more recent hands-on confirmation of mobile SDK maturity/parity with backend/web SDKs.
